g.title: public.bookings
g.text: A customer order. PENDING_PAYMENT holds its seats until expires_at
Payment deadline; 1 minute after it (grace period) the held seats are free again

g.title: public.users
g.text: Customers and cinema admins. Email is stored lower-cased.
bcrypt hash, never the plain password

g.title: public.showtimes
g.text: Jadwal tayang: one movie in one studio at one time
start_at + movie duration, set by the API
end_at + 15 minutes of cleaning; the next showtime may start from here

g.title: public.showtime_seats
g.text: Seat stock per showtime, generated when the showtime is created
Booking holding the seat. NULL, or a booking that is EXPIRED/REFUNDED/over 1 minute past expires_at, means available

g.title: public.showtime_seats:booking_id->public.bookings:id
g.text: FOREIGN KEY (booking_id, showtime_id) REFERENCES bookings(id, showtime_id)

g.title: public.tickets
g.text: Issued once a booking is PAID; VOID after a refund

g.title: public.tickets:booking_id->public.bookings:id
g.text: FOREIGN KEY (booking_id, showtime_id) REFERENCES bookings(id, showtime_id)

g.title: public.payments
g.text: Transaction id from the payment gateway; UNIQUE makes callbacks idempotent
